facts: Without a raster mask, random must be false and wordCloudConfig must exactly be {layoutMode:fast}. Named fast shapes use the same fast path.
Exactly one rotation angle is accepted. Main word.style only accepts fontFamily/fontWeight/fill; word.padding is used by masked glyph occupancy.
Mask/default layout requires both layoutMode options to be default; geometry/text/bitmap mask construction and filling options remain in word_mask helpers.
Name/value fields, sqrt size normalization, family/weight, per-word placement, stepFactor>0, minInitFontSize, keyword occupancy and repeated filling are forwarded unchanged.
fillingWord.style supplies family/weight to filling_layout, but fill color is painted by the main word.style closure; a separate filling fill is not a new supported DSL effect.
staticExclusions: Animation/tooltip/hover/state-like branches are not new features; DYNAMIC fields remain provider static ignored contract.

facts: Top-level spec accepts type/data/width/height plus exact type-specific OPTIONS; nonempty raw list records with no per-row series key.
learningCurve requires folds or summaries; fold aggregation uses score mean and optional population spread. seasonalPlot follows explicit cycle/phase order.
timeSeriesPlot requires observations/estimates and zoned ISO strings without interval bands; repeated observations with automatic estimator require errorBar=false. Null values split runs.
autocorrelationPlot lag must be int within1..n-1 and varying data; confidence false or level controls confidence bands.
KDE/violin bandwidth and bandwidthAdjust, points2..4096 and nonnegative cut with positive interval are real options.

histogram raw samples use binCount1..1000 and count/proportion/density; boxPlot raw samples use category/value and iqrMultiplier. Core dispatch selects these branches only for raw value records without xField/yField.
calibration probabilities must be0..1 and outcomes bool; ROC/PR require bool outcomes and both classes. Bool/int identity is significant.
embedding method limited to pca/tsne/umap; pairedComparison requires two ordered categories; residual input observations/predictions/residuals selects real data computation.
Dedicated renderer-specific records and nested observation shapes remain exact, not normalized to the ordinary values wrapper.
pairPlot has histogram-only diagonal, explicit distinct variables, valid nonempty categorical palette and fully assigned group labels; diagonal binCount1..200 and canvas width constraints.
hexbinPlot xBins must be int1..200; finite coordinate domains and positive plot size required; empty dataset has an explicit path.
Matrix shapes/normalization/triangle/missingness and Pearson-only correlation, minSamples/pairwise nonconstant data paths remain provider computations.
SHAP requires observations for each selected feature, relative within-feature values, missing/constant colors and collision geometry; no DSL reimplementation.
sequence accepts multiple bar/line panels with a bottom axis, inline/per-id/per-index datasets, appendPadding and per-series height/padding/grid; these nested structures must stay representable.
combinationCandlestick uses explicit candlestickSeries and optional bar/line previewSeries, numeric/percent previewHeight and price field channels.
sequenceAnalysis currently supports step mode/text lanes: mediumConnection or nonempty userImageMap values are rejected, not implied supported by key presence.
scatter sequence uses numeric JS array-index key precedence; otherwise first insertion-order frame. No key sorting by compiler/variable cloning/JSON serialization.
sequenceScatterPixel always emits300x300; backgroundColors is a per-frame RGB matrix.
sequenceScatterLink requires neighborhood taskType and explicit scope/labelColor; its first-frame nodes, confidence and node ids are static data.
KDE class labels supported0..10; infoLabel.style has actually used visible/fontSize/fillOpacity/fill/x/y paths. player is a provider-accepted field not an implemented playback feature.

limitations: Condition expressions/raises/check_keys are exact static source evidence, not a complete inferred schema or exhaustive branch-test coverage.
No provider runtime code changed, no DSL or provider behavior executed by this audit.
